name: Venerable Alexander of Oshevensk
life: Born in 1427 near Belozersk, Alexander left a wealthy family to take monastic vows at the Kirillo-Belozersk monastery, where he spent six years in humble novitiate before his calling. Heeding a miraculous voice, he founded a monastery on the River Churiuga in the Kargopol region, governing it for 27 years with a strict rule of prayer, silence, and labor until his peaceful repose in 1479.
